# simple v0.7.1 Windows x64 binary

Bundled upstream binary: `simple.dll` from the official v0.7.1 release asset
[`libsimple-windows-x64.zip`](https://github.com/wangfenjin/simple/releases/download/v0.7.1/libsimple-windows-x64.zip).

Upstream source and release: https://github.com/wangfenjin/simple/tree/v0.7.1
The upstream license is included in `LICENSE`.

This package currently includes the Windows x64 DLL and these source/license
notices. It does not include the upstream dictionaries or verification scripts.
